prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a side impact at intersection. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1386; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent our client in connection with injuries sustained in a side-impact collision at an intersection involving your insured. Please direct all further communications regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or any other means.

We request that you immediately provide the bodily injury liability policy limits applicable to your insured, along with a copy of the declarations page and confirmation of any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply.

We also ask that your company and your insured take immediate steps to preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes claim files, photographs, recorded statements, vehicle data and event data recorder information, repair and inspection records, dashcam or surveillance footage, and any other documentation in your possession, custody, or control. Any loss or destruction of such evidence may expose your insured and your company to sanctions in any resulting litigation.

We look forward to your prompt written response confirming receipt of this letter and your compliance with these requests.
